game_concept: A survival strategy set in Sand Dunes – Scorpion Canyon, a canyon of scorpions: the desert nomad must handle mirage spirits while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Validation Fortress: Write input checks that reject bad data so mirage spirits can't sneak through.
theme: Sand Dunes – Scorpion Canyon: a canyon of scorpions
core_gameplay_loop: In Scorpion Canyon, repeat each round: Write input checks that reject bad data so mirage spirits can't sneak through. Each round, mirage spirits strike the water well, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the fortress value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the water well from mirage spirits in Scorpion Canyon: keep the fortress meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 54-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: fortress drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 54-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 9 (extended tier): Validation Fortress
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Validation Fortress' (Week 9 slot 14), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Scorpion Canyon'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how fortress changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against mirage spirits in Scorpion Canyon.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 54 seconds while fortress > 0.
